description:
A Flutter LLM Chat Client. Support Android & iOS & Harmony Next.

A Flutter LLM Chat Client. Support Android & iOS & Harmony Next.
✨ Features
- 🎨 Modern Design - Material You design language with dynamic color theming support (Android 12+).
- 🌙 Dark Mode - Perfectly adapted dark theme to protect your eyes.
- 🌍 Multi-language Support - Supports both English and Chinese interfaces.
- 🖥️ Multi-platform Support - Mobile (Android/iOS/Harmony) and Desktop (Windows/macOS/Linux).
- 🔄 Multi-provider Support - Supports major AI providers like OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, etc.
- 🤖 Custom Assistants - Create and manage personalized AI assistants.
- 🖼️ Multimodal Input - Supports various formats including images, text documents, PDFs, Word documents, etc.
- 📝 Markdown Rendering - Full support for code highlighting, LaTeX formulas, tables, and more.
- 🎙️ Voice/TTS Providers - Built-in system TTS plus OpenAI / Google Gemini / ElevenLabs voice servers.
- 🛠️ MCP Support - Model Context Protocol tool integration.
- 🧰 Built-in MCP Tools - Includes a built-in MCP Fetch tool.
- 🔍 Web Search - Integrated with multiple search engines (Exa, Tavily, Zhipu, LinkUp, Brave, Bing, Metaso, SearXNG, Ollama, Jina, Perplexity, Bocha).
- 🧩 Prompt Variables - Supports dynamic variables like model name, time, etc.
- 📤 QR Code Sharing - Export and import provider configurations via QR codes.
- 💾 Data Backup - Supports chat history backup and restoration.
- 🌐 Custom Requests - Supports custom HTTP request headers and bodies.
- 🔡 Custom Fonts - Bring your own fonts (system fonts / Google Fonts).
- ⚙️ Android Background Generation - Keep chat generation running in the background (optional setting).
What's Changed
- feat: Add a models.dev model catalog and a unified model editor for input modalities, context window, pricing, and reasoning.
- feat: Pick reasoning effort from each model's supported levels, with a discrete slider and an optional badge on the input bar.
- feat: Show context usage on the input bar and the mobile header, with a stacked breakdown, estimated cost, and cost totals on the statistics page.
- feat: Show first-token latency and generation speed, with an option to sum token usage across a whole turn.
- feat: Send native audio, video, and PDF inputs, and record or play audio attachments.
- feat: Call embedding APIs for embedding models on OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, and Vertex providers.
- feat: Add Vercel AI Gateway, including provider-native web search and citations.
- feat: Add an optional conversation-level prompt cache key for OpenAI-compatible requests.
- feat: Add Exa MCP search, with an optional API key.
- feat: Read full web pages during search, using the search provider or a free local fetch.
- feat: Import SillyTavern world books.
- feat: Keep a separate input draft for each conversation, including attachments.
- feat: Choose which data to include when exporting or importing backups, for local, WebDAV, S3, Cherry, and Chatbox.
- feat: Add a workspace image viewing tool with inline previews in chat.
- feat: Import provider configs from the desktop providers page.
- fix: Replay complete reasoning and tool-call history by default, including Claude, DeepSeek, and the Responses API, and keep it after message edits and tool recovery.
- fix: Fix MCP OAuth discovery and browser authorization, and preserve tool schema constraints.
- fix: Fix phone control on live video, and stop the overlay capsule from stealing taps.
- fix: Keep haptic pulses going while a reply streams.
- fix: Stop the expanded composer from covering the title bar.
- fix: Bundle the runtime libraries required by the Linux AppImage.
- fix: Update Claude Code compatibility for Opus 5.5, and send the system prompt before messages.
- fix: Merge Grok OAuth model catalogs with their context limits.
- fix: Ask for confirmation before deleting legacy memories.
- fix: Improve Bing local search requests and result parsing.
- fix: Deep-merge custom request bodies so partial objects no longer overwrite generated fields.
- fix: Speed up long chat histories, ZIP backups, long-message editing, and Markdown previews.
- fix: Fix several other known bugs and UI issues.
Full Changelog: https://github.com/Chevey339/kelivo/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1
